about: Twilight's Eve Callings: the Warrior line (Basic Warrior, Vanguard, and Templar's locked quest; the Ironclad's kit and quest moved to the master CSV and quests.toml in #685, the Zealot's in #686), and the other Tier 1 lines (Acolyte, Cutthroat, Initiate, Ranger), whose kits live in the master CSV. Every spell, talent and tab id is a real 1.12.1 record, checked by tools/twilights-eve/extract_spells.py verify. Design notes: docs/reference/skills-and-talents.md.

formula_conventions.L: the character's level inside its current Tier (1..Tier Cap); it resets to 1 on Advancement
formula_conventions.AP: melee attack power at cast time (Battle Shout and other buffs included)
formula_conventions.W: a normal white-swing damage roll: rand(weapon min..max) + AP / 14 * weapon speed (unarmed: 1..2 dmg at speed 2.0)
formula_conventions.Wn: a normalized roll: rand(weapon min..max) + AP / 14 * normalized speed (2.4 one-hand, 3.3 two-hand, 1.7 dagger), as vanilla Overpower and Mortal Strike
formula_conventions.linear: {base, per_level, per_ap} means round(base + per_level * L + per_ap * AP), rounding half away from zero, never below `min` (default 0)
formula_conventions.rage: rage values are whole rage points; Spell.dbc stores rage costs in tenths (150 = 15 rage)
formula_conventions.realm_vs_client: `client` is what Spell.dbc makes the stock client show and enforce before it sends a cast (cost, range, stance, aura states, on-next-swing); it is checked by the extractor. `realm` is what the Local Realm does; it must keep realm cost >= client cost or the client refuses casts the realm would allow.

tier_bonus.about: Flat additions to base stats (UNIT_FIELD_STAT0..4 base values), cumulative per Tier, applied on top of the race/class base table at the character's current level. +12 Stamina is about +120 health, so a level 1 Tier 1 Warrior (~180 hp) sits near a level 7 Basic Warrior; +12 Strength is +24 attack power.

basic_warrior.armour_note: Gear follows the Calling, never the level: every Warrior weapon from level 1, this armour, and no item refused for level. Plate is for Vanguard and every Calling that branches from it.
basic_warrior.client_shapeshift_form_note: Battle Stance. The stock client refuses a cast whose Spell.dbc Stances mask excludes the current form (0x612480), before sending it. Charge, Rend, Thunder Clap, Hamstring and Overpower all need Battle Stance, so the realm keeps UNIT_FIELD_BYTES_1 byte 2 = 17 for every Warrior Calling. It also makes GetBonusBarOffset() 1, so the main action bar pages to slots 73..84.

skills.name: Heroic Strike
skills.vanilla_reference: R1 L1 +11, R2 L8 +21, R3 L16 +32, R4 L24 +44: bonus = 9.5 + 1.4 L fits within 1 point to L24.
skills.tooltip_note: Tooltip says +11 (rank 1) at every level; the realm adds more from L2.

skills.name: Charge
skills.tooltip_note: Tooltip says 9 rage; realm gives 9 at L1-10.

vanguard.client_shapeshift_form_note: Battle Stance again: every Vanguard skill below is legal in it. Thunder Clap, Cleave and Execute were dropped for the handoff's focused kit.

skills.name: Mortal Strike
skills.vanilla_reference: R1 L40 +85 (talent, 31 points deep). Given as the Tier 1 signature strike: +28 at L1, +100 at L30 (tuned with tools/twilights-eve/simulate_fights.py).

realm.requires: as Basic Warrior's Overpower (combo point on dodge)

skills.name: Battle Shout
skills.tooltip_note: Tooltip says 55 until L22, then +0.5/level (its own scaling) up to 59 at L30; the realm gives 22 at L1 rising to 80 at L30.

advancement_quest.zone_or_sort_note: QuestSort.dbc 81 'Warrior': the stock quest log files it under a Warrior header.
advancement_quest.title: The Warrior's Path
advancement_quest.details: You have learned all a Basic Warrior can learn, $N. Strength alone carried you this far; from here, discipline must carry you further.$B$BTake up the warrior's path and you begin again, untested, among the youngest of our blades. But you will not be the same fighter you were. Your body remembers. Your arm is stronger.$B$BSay the word, and it begins.
advancement_quest.objectives: Speak with the Vanguard Trainer at the Crossroads to take up the warrior's path.
advancement_quest.offer_reward_text: Then it is done. Forget your old habits, $N: you are a Vanguard now, and a Vanguard starts over. Go and earn your scars again.

objective.note: No item or kill: accept and complete at the same NPC, like vanilla's 'Veteran Uzzek' (1505) speak-to quest.

advancement_quest.flavour_source: Vanilla Horde warrior quests 1505 'Veteran Uzzek' and 1498 'Path of Defense' (Uzzek, Far Watch Post, the Barrens, creature 5810) for tone only; no text is copied.

advancement_quest.zone_or_sort_note: QuestSort.dbc 162 'Rogue': the quest log's Rogue header.
advancement_quest.title: The Cutthroat's Mark
advancement_quest.details: You swing that blade like it owe you money, $N. Strength be fine, but da Cutthroats fight smarter: quick feet, a knife in da dark, and gone before da body fall.$B$BTake da mark and you begin again, a novice among us. No more rage: you fight on Energy now, and every cut you land set up da one dat finish it.$B$BSay da word.
advancement_quest.objectives: Speak with the Cutthroat Trainer at the Crossroads to take the Cutthroat's mark.

objective.note: As The Warrior's Path: accept and complete at the trainer.

advancement_quest.request_items_text: Say da word, $N, and take da mark.

advancement_quest.details: There is more in you than a strong arm, $N. I feel it when you pass: a spark, waiting for someone to fan it.$B$BAccept it and you begin again, a novice of the circle. No more rage: you draw on mana now, and you strike from afar with fire and frost, then break what you have woven.$B$BSay the word.

advancement_quest.title: The Ranger's Draw
advancement_quest.details: You fight close, $N, close enough to bleed. A Ranger chooses the distance: a quick arrow while moving, a heavy shaft when the feet are planted.$B$BAccept it and you begin again, a novice of the lodge. No more rage: you draw on mana now, and every step you keep between you and the blade is yours.$B$BSay the word.

advancement_quest.title: The Acolyte's Vein
advancement_quest.details: You have bled for every fight, $N, and never once made the blood work for you. An Acolyte does: we spend our own life to rot our foes, and drink theirs to mend our own.$B$BAccept it and you begin again, a novice of the order. No more rage: you draw on mana, and on your own veins when mana will not do.$B$BSay the word.

advancement_quest.title: The Templar's Charge
advancement_quest.details: Fifty battles of holy fury, and the Light hasn't burned you out yet. The Templars have heard of you, $N.$B$BThey guard what the Zealots only strike for, and they choose their own. When they're ready to test you, I'll send word. Until then, keep your Seals bright.

objective.note: As The Ironclad's Oath: offered, never finished.

advancement_quest.request_items_text: The Templars haven't sent for you yet, $N. Patience.
